person_note: The book’s base narration is third person. Numerous interior quotes sustain an external narrator across Joey, Chaz, Tool, Rolvaag, Stranahan, and Red while also reporting their private perceptions and thoughts. The authorized opening independently shows the same structure and explicitly embeds Joey’s first-person thoughts inside third-person narration, resolving the apparent first-person language in q00312 and q00340. Dialogue and other local first-person statements are non-base. The principal limitation is that the Tier A web excerpt covers only the opening, but the broad interior quote sample supplies strong, consistent corroboration and reveals no sustained first- or second-person section.
